blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use & Site Checks in Sumas Mountain

parts.t: Lower bench subdivisions in Auguston and McKee are serviced by municipal water and sanitary sewer under the McKee Neighbourhood Plan, whereas upper Sumas Mountain and Straiton properties carry Rural Residential (RR2/RR3) or Agricultural/Forestry zoning on private drilled wells and onsite septic systems. Most hillside parcels fall within the Steep Slope Development Permit Area and Wildfire Interface Development Permit Area.
